This class will make you comfortable in Excel & familiar with R, while preparing you to apply the concepts in real-life since we complete such scenarios nearly every class. reviews.comment: Sharma is one of my favorite professors ever. His class can be somewhat difficult but he is a great teacher and is very kind and very generous with his grading.

Came here to write my first review ever because Amalesh Sharma is the best prof at Mays. Useful material but he is very flexible and helpful. Lots of extra credit, but you can use resources on any assignment to include his only exam, the midterm. Gives partial credit.
Literally the funniest professor I've ever had. He is super smart and knowledgeable. Don't be afraid to ask for help, he will help you gladly. This semester was too short with him.

Professor Sharma cares about his students and offers chances to ask for clarification throughout his lectures. While the subject material may not be the most interesting, he makes a good effort to explain things clearly to his students. Go to class, pay attention, and contribute in the group project and you'll be fine. Extra credit too.
He is the best professor you will have in the marketing department, all he cares about is his students learning how to code. Overall great professor.

reviews.comment: Professor Sharma is the best! The class is a bit challenging and he goes very fast in lecture, but he is so willing to answer questions and really cares about his students. There is a midterm and no final exam. The midterm was very doable, was open note, and involved coding in excel and SAS. The group project was easy and there was extra credit.

He's a great professor and will answer any questions you have. He goes a little fast in lecture sometimes but always asks if he needs to repeat anything. Course is graded by a few assignments (1 midterm, 4 group assignments, and a final project), but it's very manageable and not too hard if you pay attention in lecture and follow along!

Class was graded by 1 midterm, 2 group assignments, and a final project. The class is easy in that everything is done in a group, but if youre really looking to learn the material it's a bit of a challenge. He teaches quickly so pay close attention, take good notes, and don't be afraid to stop him if you missed something. He is super nice and cool!
